title: Finite-basis columns of the restricted canonical coefficient mate
statement:
For a scheme morphism q:Z to W, normalized scalar models [def-sp-finite-free-direct-image-data], a compatible coefficient map a:R to S, and an R_W-module isomorphism S_W to the free rank-d module sheaf, the restricted scalar extension of Rq_R M and that of M admit finite biproduct coordinate isomorphisms eW and eZ. Under these coordinates, the canonical restricted comparison, followed by the normalized restriction/direct-image isomorphism, has column i equal to Rq_R of the corresponding basis inclusion on Z. This includes d=0 and makes no assertion of invertibility or shift/tower coherence.

theorem finiteFreeDirectImage_columns {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (q : Z ⟶ W)
    (sW : ScalarModel W) (sZ : ScalarModel Z)
    (R S : Coefficients q) (a : CoefficientMap R S) (d : ℕ)
    (hfree : Nonempty ((proEtaleRingRestrictScalars a.target).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology W)
              (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj S.target)) ≅
          SheafOfModules.free (R := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology W)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R.target)
            (ULift.{u + 1} (Fin d))))
    (M : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules Z R.source)) :
    ∃ (eW : (⨁ fun _ : Fin d ↦
        (proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage q R.target R.source R.identification).obj M) ≅
        (proEtaleRingRestrictScalars a.target).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((sW.presentation a.target).derived.obj
            ((proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage q R.target R.source R.identification).obj M)))
      (eZ : (⨁ fun _ : Fin d ↦ M) ≅
        (proEtaleRingRestrictScalars a.source).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((sZ.presentation a.source).derived.obj M)),
      ∀ i : Fin d,
        biproduct.ι _ i ≫ eW.hom ≫
          (proEtaleRingRestrictScalars a.target).mapDerivedCategory.map
            ((comparison sW sZ a).app M) ≫
          (proEtaleRingRestrictionDerivedDirectImage q R.target S.target R.source S.source
            a.target a.source R.identification S.identification a.comm).hom.app
              ((sZ.presentation a.source).derived.obj M) =
        (proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage q R.target R.source R.identification).map
          (biproduct.ι _ i ≫ eZ.hom)

proof.text: Choose the displayed finite basis of S_W over R_W. Its inverse-image basis gives S_Z over R_Z through the two fixed coefficient identifications. The maps from a finite tuple to the sum of basis tensors and from a tensor to its coordinate tuple are mutually inverse by tensor balancing. They are natural and commute with sheaf restrictions. Consequently scalar extension is exact, and the same finite-biproduct coordinates compute its universal unbounded derived functor after passing to complexes and localizing. The empty basis gives the zero functor.

proof.text: The ordinary tensor-unit normalization and identity-section restriction comparison identify the conjugate balancing with the usual balanced pullback map. Compute on flat-term K-flat representatives and descend by localization uniqueness. Apply the restriction adjunct identity to the counit transpose defining comparison. On each basis summand this transpose is the R-geometric counit followed by the basis inclusion on Z. Adjunction naturality makes its adjunct Rq_R of that inclusion. This proves the asserted column equality as an equality in D(R_W), without requiring faithful scalar forgetting on derived Hom.
